notes.title: Performance Update!
notes.content:
We've done a performance pass on Store Wars and found a few things that were hogging resources. We've updated a handful of things to be more efficient on the CPU and GPU.

One of the main offenders was the security camera screen in the jail. While we like the idea of security cameras and their possibilities, the performance impact on our test system was nearly 30% for a single security screen.
